summary: Well-structured test suite covering all main requirements (JUnit/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown rendering, CLI). Organized into clear test classes with good separation between unit and workflow structure tests. Good error handling coverage. Weaknesses: limited edge case testing (empty results, special characters, boundary values), relies on fixture files that aren't shown in the prompt (correctness unverifiable), and missing some boundary conditions (Unicode, very long names, malformed-but-not-parse-error XML). Error tests are present but would benefit from more varied scenarios. The test design is solid and would catch most regressions in main code paths, but gaps in edge cases and boundary conditions reduce confidence for robustness against unusual inputs.
